ED_DecisionText:
A 

At its 69th (resumed) plenary meeting, on 30 December 2025, the General Assembly, on the recommendation of the Fifth Committee, (Footnote: A/80/568, para.19.) The General Assembly decided to defer until the main part of its eighty-first session consideration of the following documents: 

Item 136 
Proposed programme budget for 2026 
Estimates in respect of special political missions 
Report of the Secretary-General on the review of arrangements for funding and backstopping special political missions  (Footnote: A/66/340.)
Related report of the Advisory Committee on Administrative and Budgetary Questions  (Footnote: A/66/7/Add.21.)

B [Footnote: Decision 80/526, in section B.6 of the Official Records of the General Assembly, Eightieth Session, Supplement No. 49 (A/80/49), vol. II, becomes decision 80/526 A.] 

At its 78th plenary meeting, on 15 April 2026, the General Assembly, on the recommendation of the Fifth Committee, (Footnote: A/80/568/Add.1, para15.) 

Section A 

Decided to defer until the second part of its resumed eightieth session consideration of the following documents: 

Item 134 

Review of the efficiency of the administrative and financial functioning of the United Nations 

Proposed revisions to the Financial Regulations of the United Nations 

Report of the Secretary-General on proposed revisions to the Financial Regulations of the United Nations (Footnote: A/80/367.) 

Related report of the Advisory Committee on Administrative and Budgetary Questions (Footnote: A/80/7/Add.29.) 

Proposed revisions to the Regulations and Rules Governing Programme Planning, the Programme Aspects of the Budget, the Monitoring of Implementation and the Methods of Evaluation 

Report of the Secretary-General on proposed revisions to the Regulations and Rules Governing Programme Planning, the Programme Aspects of the Budget, the Monitoring of Implementation and the Methods of Evaluation (Footnote: A/80/69/Rev.1.) 

Section B 

Decided to defer until the main part of its eighty-first session consideration of the following documents: 

Item 135 

Programme budget for 2025 

Standards of accommodation for air travel 

Report of the Secretary-General on standards of accommodation for air travel (Footnote: A/79/628.) 

Related report of the Advisory Committee on Administrative and Budgetary Questions (Footnote: A/79/7/Add.44.) 

Section C 

Decided to defer until the first part of its resumed eighty-first session consideration of the following documents:   

Item 134 

Review of the efficiency of the administrative and financial functioning of the United Nations 

Cost recovery 

Report of the Secretary-General on cost recovery in the United Nations Secretariat (Footnote: A/80/369.) 

Related report of the Advisory Committee on Administrative and Budgetary Questions (Footnote: A/80/475.) 

Item 141 

Human resources management 

Report of the Secretary-General on the review of the United Nations Secretariat Internship Programme (Footnote: A/79/566/Add.1.) 

Related report of the Advisory Committee on Administrative and Budgetary Questions (Footnote: A/79/746.)
